answer: The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, held in escrow until finality, no identity may audit its own recruit. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the river of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The yarrow lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the oasis is where a second reviewer recomputes them.
